title: Root and pattern table
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 14 (Root and pattern table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 14: Bridge: the active and passive participle. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

parts.text: Active: ف→ش، ع→ر، ل→ب in فَاعِل: شَارِب (drinker)
Passive in مَفْعُول: مَشْرُوب (a drink, drunk)
Use it: المَشْرُوبُ بَارِدٌ (the drink is cold)

panels.title: Participles as adjectives
points: البَابُ مَفْتُوحٌ: the door is open
الكُرْسِيُّ مَكْسُورٌ: the chair is broken
الطَّالِبُ جَالِسٌ: the student is sitting

keywords.def: passive participle: the thing done to

questions.q: Make both participles from س ك ن (living).

questions.a: The book is written in Arabic.

questions.q: Active participle of ك ت ب?
Core: Complete the table for the roots د ر س، ف ت ح، ع ر ف، ح ف ظ: active participle, passive participle, meaning.
questions.a: دَارِس / مَدْرُوس (studier / studied); فَاتِح / مَفْتُوح (opener / open); عَارِف / مَعْرُوف (knower / known, good deed); حَافِظ / مَحْفُوظ (one who memorises, a hafidh / memorised, preserved)

questions.q: Extend: Write three sentences using a passive participle as an adjective.
questions.a: For example: البَابُ مَفْتُوحٌ. الدَّرْسُ مَفْهُومٌ. الكَاتِبُ مَشْهُورٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: Find a word on the مَفْعُول pattern in Surah al-Fatihah.
questions.a: المَغْضُوبِ (those who earned anger) in غَيْرِ المَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ

questions.q: From ف ت ح, which means 'opened'?
questions.a: B) مَفْتُوح. مَفْعُول pattern = passive participle: مَفْتُوح.

questions.q: What does اِسْمُ الفَاعِلِ name? A) the doer B) the thing done C) the place
Big question: how does one root give 'writer' and 'written'?
questions.a: The root ك ت ب goes into the patterns فَاعِل (كَاتِب) and مَفْعُول (مَكْتُوب).
